mapper.sql: id, user_id, amount, transaction_type, reference_key, description, balance_after, reverses_transaction_id, created_by, reason, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, balance, free_trip_quota_used, created_at, updated_at FROM user_star_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, balance, free_trip_quota_used, created_at, updated_at FROM user_star_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_star_wallets(user_id) VALUES(#{userId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO star_transactions (id, user_id, amount, transaction_type, reference_key, description, balance_after, reverses_transaction_id, created_by, reason) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{transactionType}, #{referenceKey}, #{description}, #{balanceAfter}, #{reversesTransactionId}, #{createdBy}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM star_transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM star_transactions WHERE reference_key = #{referenceKey}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM star_transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT w.user_id FROM user_star_wallets w LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM star_transactions GROUP BY user_id ) t ON t.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.balance <> COALESCE(t.total, 0) LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_creation_entitlements(id, user_id, stars_spent, expires_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{starsSpent}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, stars_spent, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM trip_creation_entitlements WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_creation_entitlements WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_creation_entitlements WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_creation_entitlements SET consumed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trip_id, t.owner_id FROM trips t LEFT JOIN activities a ON a.trip_id = t.id LEFT JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.trip_id = t.id AND ma.entity_type IN ('TRIP_MEMORY', 'TRIP_ACTIVITY_MEMORY') AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.end_date < CURRENT_DATE AND t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND t.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY t.id, t.owner_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ma.id) >= 5
